conventions.status: automated = a test performs the action AND asserts an outcome (mapped_by=tag: the test names the case; mapped_by=heuristic: static key/label match); presence_only = tests find/tap the control without asserting its effect; partial = covered indirectly; manual = cannot be automated locally (manual_reason; checked by a person in QA Lab); not_automated = no test
conventions.case_tags: Flutter/Playwright: [case:<id>] in the test name (interpolated ids are expanded only to string literals of the file); pytest: @pytest.mark.case("<id>") incl. pytest.param marks; Go: // case: <id> above func TestX; Django: [case:<id>] in the test method docstring (or # case: <id> above def test_x)
conventions.extra_cases: qa/catalog/extra_cases.json declares controls/cases/features static extraction cannot see; each has a reason (why_declared)
conventions.api: statically inferred from callback → provider → Dio call; verify where action says 'unclassified'
conventions.qa_key: ValueKey('qa.*') or Semantics label/identifier 'qa.*' (Appium content-desc); '*' = interpolated id
